title: The Fast Track to Global Expansion: Consistency Across Every Site
summary: For cell and gene therapy developers, expansion is rarely as simple as adding a new country or introducing a new logistics lane. What appears to be a straightforward geographic scale-up often triggers operational and quality challenges through supplier requalification, packaging validation reviews, local process assessments, documentation updates, and regulatory scrutiny. Systems that must be rebuilt every time new market entry is desired slows progress and, as clinical trials become increasingly global, organizations need infrastructure that scales with them.
